status: experimental; Windows Photoshop 27.0 tested, broader host stability unverified

photoshop.mode: RGB / Grayscale 8/16-bit (native sRGB, Adobe RGB and Gray Gamma 2.2 matrix passed)
photoshop.modelPixels: Inputs: sRGB8; outputs: sRGB8 or tagged sRGB RGB/RGBA16 SDR with optional PS_AISavePNG16

colorAcceptance.method: Native identity round trip and independent Photoshop Convert to Profile, native-depth source/mask/alpha/undo comparison
colorAcceptance.limitations: Original matrix covers sRGB8 exchange. Model inputs clip wide gamut and quantize precision; optional16 output acceptance recorded separately. No calibrated-display acceptance or long-term stability claim.

photoshop.untaggedSource: Blocked; assign the correct source profile to a copy explicitly

service.addressPolicy: HTTP(S) origin with configurable host and port; no credentials, URL path, query or fragment

workflow.alternateModels: Compatible Qwen 2.1 GGUF weights only; each combination requires an inference test
workflow.pngOutput: 8-bit sRGB. Untagged allowed only for qwen21-local-v2-rgba; incompatible ICC/gamma/HDR metadata rejected.

output16.dependencies: ComfyUI existing NumPy; Python standard library
output16.status: unpublished development version; automated codec, backend inference and native sRGB16 acceptance passed

nativeAcceptance.modes: Six selection edits and two standalone assets at16; text-to-image at8 for backward compatibility
nativeAcceptance.gui: Two serial16 candidates, same-capture replacement, exact PNG16 export, actual sampling-step progress and task-specific cancellation
nativeAcceptance.limitations: Output16 was native-tested in sRGB16, not a new all-profile16 matrix. Background/scene tests used a selected crop, not full-image quality grading. No calibrated-display or long-term crash-free acceptance.

walkthroughAcceptance.compositing: Effect and atmosphere copied into sample derivatives as separate layers, 900x900 at (50,555), Normal at approximately 85% and 35%.
walkthroughAcceptance.limitations: One illustration and fixed model preset. Clothing transfer, not identity consistency or complex prop reconstruction. Invisible RGB under zero alpha excluded from composite appearance comparison. Asset alpha can contain faint residue; first effect prompt formed a rejected ring. English prompt translations not separately tested. No long-term stability or calibrated-display claim.
